availableLiquidity(address).notice: Returns the amount of immediately available tokens held in this contract.

balanceOf(address,address).notice: Returns the underlying balance of an address.

baseUnits(address).notice: Maps underlying assets to their base units.

borrow(address,uint256).notice: Borrow underlying tokens from the pool.

borrowBalance(address,address).notice: Returns the underlying borrow balance of an address.

configurations(address).notice: Maps underlying tokens to their configurations.

configureAsset(address,address,(uint256,.notice: Adds a new asset to the pool. If this is not a new asset, this updates     the lend/borrow factors and, if desired, the vault of an asset.

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposit underlying tokens into the pool.

enableAsset(address).notice: Any user can enable an asset as collateral. Only enabled assests will be considered as collateral.

enabledCollateral(address,address).notice: Maps users to a map of assets to booleans indicating if an asset is enabled as collateral.

interestRateModels(address).notice: Maps ERC20 token addresses to their respective Interest Rate Model.

liquidateUser(address,address,uint256).notice: Partially or fully Liquidates a borrower with poor health factor

oracle().notice: Address of the price oracle contract.

repay(address,uint256).notice: Repay underlying tokens to the pool.Only USDC can be repayed for now.

setGMPointsContract(address).notice: Sets a new GM Points contract.

setGloopStakersWallet(address).notice: Sets the wallet that will receive a portion of fees for Gloop stakers.

setInterestRateModel(address,address,boo.notice: Sets a new Interest Rate Model for a specfic asset.

totalBorrows(address).notice: Returns the total amount of underlying tokens being loaned out to borrowers.

totalUnderlying(address).notice: Returns the total amount of underlying tokens held by or owed to the pool.

updateLiquidationBonus(uint256).notice: Authorized user can update the liquidation Bonus

userCollateral(address,uint256).notice: Maps users to an array of assets they have listed as collateral.

vaults(address).notice: Maps underlying tokens to the ERC4626 vaults where they are held.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw underlying tokens from the pool.

withdrawStakersYield(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw stakers' yield from the pool to the GLOOP Staker Wallet.
